name: spec-only-merge-defect-recorded
body: A splice equals a full rebuild for every table: `rust.apg.splice.apply.apply` matches every authored/transient kind alongside Language/Module/Struct/Function/File, and `rust.apg.splice.publish.publish` swaps in a seeded+spliced `db.lbug` carrying the same rows its `graph.jsonl` (`rust.apg.load.export.write_graph_jsonl`) carries. `rust.apg.scan.cmd_scan` takes its fast path on `rust.apg.git.state.is_fresh`, which reads the scan state `rust.apg.git.state.recorded_scan` records and `rust.apg.git.commit.reanchor_scan_meta` re-anchors; the eligibility guard refuses the splice and performs a full load whenever the seeded content diverges from that recorded scan state.
